correctness.rationale: The original finite-ring generator admits uniform canonical sector law by telescoping local incoming/outgoing rate differences, and the infinite stationary current is Popkov eq (11). At sum p=1, J=(2A+gamma)e2+3gamma e3. Exact Schur bound 4e2−9e3≤1 with equality only balanced face or uniform yields the two global switch thresholds −2A, −6A/7. Tangent Hessian at uniform and inward gradient at balanced face give distinct strict local-maxima coexistence window −A<gamma<−4A/5. Independent rational symbolic and finite grid tests corroborated algebra, but proof is continuous inequality, not numerical search. Rates remain strictly positive for every real coupling with positive offset.
residual_risks: Fixed sector density allocations externally chosen; no dynamical symmetry breaking, finite-size coexistence law or physical hysteresis asserted.
